subject: control order of groups in dotplot

messages.author: 88157018b214728a
messages.subject: control order of groups in dotplot
parts: In Deducer, how can I control the order of groups in a dotplot?  When I create a dotplot the groups on the graph are in a different order than they were on the original spreadsheet.  How do I fix this or control the order?  Thanks for any help and information you have to offer me!

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: control order of groups in dotplot
parts:
the easiest way is to edit the order of the levels in the factor editor (http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php?n=Main.EditFactor). If it is not already a factor, coerse it in the variable view in the data viewer.

ian

messages.subject: Recent version not opening CSV or TAB files?
parts:
Hi all,

I installed the latest version of Deducer after the R update to 3.02.
For some inexplicable reason the data viewer will no longer open CSV or
TAB delimited files as usual.

The pop up window indicates "reading" and then I can check Header box
then Console window indicates
>"Error in CBC - All <- read.table("C:/Health monitor/R plot
data/CBC-All.txt", :
object 'CBC' not found"

Also tried opening from Excel and same results
> CBC-All <- readWorksheet(loadWorkbook('C:/Health monitor/R plot
data/CBC-All.xlsx'),sheet=1)
Error in CBC - All <- readWorksheet(loadWorkbook("C:/Health monitor/R
plot data/CBC-All.xlsx"), :
object 'CBC' not found
Even several previously saved *ROBJ files fail to open?
Suggestions welcomed.

Bruce
